Lemma
[Extension from a Hölder domain] 1. ch6:6.37\group gt-ch06 Let $\Omega $ be a $C^{k,\alpha }$ domain, $k\ge 1$, and let $\Omega '$ contain $\bar\Omega $. For $u\in C^{k,\alpha }(\bar\Omega )$ there is $w\in C_0^{k,\alpha }(\Omega ')$ with $w=u$ on $\Omega $ and \begin{equation} \tag {6.94} |w|_{k,\alpha ;\Omega '}\le C(k,\Omega ,\Omega ')|u|_{k,\alpha ;\Omega }. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch In flattened coordinates extend across $y_n=0$ by

\[ \widetilde u(y',y_n)=\sum _{i=1}^{k+1}c_i\widetilde u(y',-y_n/i),\qquad \sum _{i=1}^{k+1}c_i(-1/i)^m=1\ (0\le m\le k). \]

This preserves derivatives through order $k$ and the Hölder seminorm. Patch the local extensions with a finite partition of unity and multiply by a cutoff.

□
